method.coordinates: Transform word and vector-rectangle coordinates through page.rotation_matrix; infer first column from leftmost long vertical borders; split at horizontal borders.
method.cellText: Sort words in first-column region by rotated Y band then X; preserve raw token before classification.
method.classification: Full standard dotted-ID match versus short nonstandard numeric identifier; all other regions empty or header/unclassified.
method.receiptDigest: SHA256 JSON array of per-cell bbox/kind/rawCellSha256,keys sorted,separators comma/colon
method.rawCellDigest: SHA256 exact extracted UTF8 cell token
limitations: Geometry gives candidate regions,not validated physical table rows.
Rotation,merged borders,headers,wrapped text and page continuations require review.
No semantic normalization or source approval applied.
Detailed raw extraction remains transient local intermediate; repository contains aggregate receipts only.

knownTokenAssertions.meaning: Known malformed/wrapped tokens preserved at correct page without identity correction.
